axes.x: easting relative to Elevador Lacerda origin
axes.z: northing relative to Elevador Lacerda origin
axes.y: elevation relative to local vertical datum

osm.notes: Complete versioned OSM bbox snapshot is active for the project perimeter. Derived runtime vectors contain all configured critical roads; live OSM remains refresh/debug only.

conderContours.notes: Official CONDER 1992 contour snapshot is versioned for the project envelope and derives the persistent 2.5 m terrain grid. Runtime live refresh is fallback-only when the persistent product is unavailable.

salvadorMunicipalCartography.notes: Prefer municipal MDT/LiDAR for final terrain when a stable public download or service endpoint for the project tile is identified.

terrainDerivation.notes: CONDER contour elevations are fixed constraints. Unknown grid cells are initialized from nearest contour cells and solved by harmonic relaxation.

vectorDerivation.notes: Road centerlines and polygons are clipped to the project perimeter. Explicit OSM width/height tags are preserved; deterministic defaults remain marked estimated. Complete coverage requires every critical road name to be present.

buildingBlockoutPolicy.notes: Automatic building volumes require a real OSM footprint plus explicit height or building:levels-derived height. Footprints crossing more than 0.75 m of terrain relief are skipped for manual foundation/model handling.

rasterReference.purpose: runtime alignment/debug reference only; not a source of 3D geometry

liveTerrainPreview.notes: Browser preview grid with 4 m spacing and 2 m contour constraints. It may replace the procedural fallback during a session but never promotes itself to geospatial/derived terrain. Persistent terrain remains the higher-resolution 2.5 m product.

roadSurfacePolicy.notes: Gameplay road mesh follows OSM centerlines and active terrain. Longitudinal smoothing may only raise local depressions by up to 0.12 m and never cuts below official terrain. Crossfall is capped at 6% by preserving the higher terrain edge and raising only the lower edge. Where this creates more than 0.18 m of support, a terrain-connected retaining skirt is rendered; automatic road fill is limited to 12 m. Compatible road endpoints receive a junction deck fitted to their graded road-edge elevations, capped at 14% plane slope. Junction terrain is masked only beneath the deck, allowing at most 0.75 m local cut and 3 m local fill, with a perimeter retaining/cut wall. These are rendering/gameplay constraints, not surveyed civil-engineering elevations.

publicSpaceSurfacePolicy.notes: Walkable plazas and pedestrian polygons are tessellated before terrain draping so collision triangles do not bridge across terrain relief. This is a rendering/gameplay mesh policy; source polygon boundaries remain unchanged.

terrainQualityPolicy.notes: Persistent official terrain must preserve the 2.5 m grid or better, retain broad contour coverage, converge below 2 mm solver delta and represent meaningful Cidade Baixa/Cidade Alta relief. These thresholds validate the derived product, not the source survey accuracy.

terrainStructureMaskPolicy.notes: Verified structure footprints may mask terrain render/collision triangles beneath their volume without changing source terrain elevations. Padding is presentation-only and prevents terrain triangles from poking through structure walls.
